notes.title: Mod Editor Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to share a recent update with you all – the Mod Editor is now available. It introduces two methods for creating mods, each catering to different preferences and skill levels:

Using Editor: This tool allows you to modify game objects without needing to code. It provides a straightforward method to alter the built-in objects.

If you have programming skills, you can take your modifications further by creating custom components. These components can be attached to the objects you are editing, enabling you to introduce new behaviors and features that extend beyond the built-in functionalities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/e176fce2e44633d8726f888503266e30f7d4b1e7.png

C# Programming: With C#, you can develop complex mods that can include tools, liquids, game scripts, etc. Visual Studio is recommended for these tasks, and understanding C# is necessary.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/d5b1f86a4b47eb55b377bdf8ccde774f06e0dd7c.png

Documentation is available to guide you through using both the Editor and programming mods in C#. It includes step-by-step tutorials, examples, and tips to help you utilize the tools effectively. You can access this information directly from within the game or by visiting the website: Regular Human Workshop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/5f47de4ce4eeee2aa43b35fb35b4d6538f3dd09d.png

I'm now heading back to focus on developing new content. Cheers!

notes.title: Mod Editor Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to inform you that the beta version of the Mod Editor Update has been released. It is available on the beta branch, as the Mod Editor is still a work in progress. However, it has reached a stage where you can begin using it to create content. I will continue to make updates to the editor until it is ready for the public release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/491a641af7c95908cc3fa4978ec93b1a14950674.png

Beta Update Includes:
New Serializer:

 Contraptions will now be serialized with the new serializer. The old one will still be present, but only be used to deserialize old contraptions.
 Ability to edit contraption data such as name, description, and upload thumbnail images.
 Ability to overwrite contraption

Game Settings:

 Settings will be saved to a JSON file and not the registry.

File System Changes:

 All user files will be kept in the "UserData" directory

Catalog:

 Catalog has a search bar

Mod Editor:

 While still not fully finished, you can edit guns, sharp-tipped weapons, and simple physical objects like bricks.
 Change/Upload images
 Add/Remove/Edit collider components
 Assign/Create physical materials
 Assign/Create physical materials sounds
 Edit guns properties
 Edit gun sounds
 Assign gun projectile
 Edit sharp weapons properties
 Assign/Create sharp weapon damage data
 And more


The Mod Editor will have the ability to upload your own custom components, further enhancing the modification capabilities of objects.

*Please note that the update has not been fully finished and tested, so you should expect some bugs and changes. If you run into any problems, please let me know, and I will fix them as soon as possible.

Hot To Select Beta Branch:

To access the properties of a Regular Human Workshop game in your Steam library, select the game, click on the “Settings” button, and choose “Properties” from the options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/b949942aa1f276d20f589d474464b80c3a92c697.png

In the Properties window, please select the “Betas” option. Then, from the dropdown menu, select the beta branch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/5d40321d7c4721ba87f99a348a93dc1ed1494806.png

notes.title: Band-Aid
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

New “Band-Aid” update includes:

Liquids Injection Devices:

 Syringe
 Injector
 Injection Gun

Vials of Liquid (for injection devices):

 Blood Vial
 Clotting Drug Vial
 Steroids Vial
 Immortality Serum Vial
 Acid Vial
 Painkiller Drug Vial
 Health Serum Vial
 Chloroform Vial
 LD-Virus Vial
 Skin Eating Poison Vial
 Death Poison Vial

Ragdoll Changes:

 The head has a brain, so now if you shoot or stab into the head, but don't touch the brain, the body will not die instantly.
 The chest has a heart, if the heart is shot or stabbed, it will kill all organs and the body will die after some time.
 The chest has lungs, if the lungs are shot or stabbed, they will die and stop producing oxygen for the body, which will cause the body to die after some time.
 Dead limbs will rot and, if not healed or cut off, will pass rot to the healthy limbs and will cause the body to die.
 Joints can be dislocated with force.
 Limbs can be crushed with force and some guns can explode limbs from close range, same for explosives.
 Blood drops will spawn blood splatters when they hit something.
 Added “Heal” button to the context menu.

Sharp Weapons:

 Sharp weapons will spawn wounds when a limb is pierced.

Inspection Mode:

 Can be activated by pressing the “D” key, the key can be changed in the settings → controls menu. When activated, will show limbs health, and ghost link attachment points.

New Tools:

 Flexible Rope Tool
 Spring Tool
 Fixed Pin Tool
 Fixed Destructible Pin Tool
 Band-Aid Tool
 Bandage Tool
 Ghost Link Tool

Additional Settings:

 Physics Iterations option (Settings→General)
 Infinite Vial Liquid option (Settings→General)
 Drop Item on Death option (Settings→General)
 Limb Crush option (Settings→Gore)
 Joint Dislocation option (Settings→Gore)
 Reset controls to default option (Settings→Controls)

Some bug fixes and other small improvements

What's Next?
I'm sorry it took so long to release the update. I needed to rework the ragdoll code in order to make an editor for it and functional clothing, this stuff will be in the future updates, but it was necessary to do it right now. From now on I will be releasing smaller updates, but more rapidly, with a main focus on making editors for modifying and creating items and mod API. I will start making an editor for simple objects and add some of your requests next.

notes.title: Skins Editor
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to announce the first game update. This update includes the "Skins Editor" feature, which allows you to create your own skins for humans and share them with other players via Steam Workshop.

How to create skin:

1. When you start the game, you will see a new button in the main menu called "Skins Editor". Click on it to enter editor.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/a297418e657d53c8c1e9e2d8e9ce2a63e09bb8fc.png

2. Download the skin template to your computer by clicking on the "Download skin template" button.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/112738b108e87909c4f30d03aaffe0ffa1747a4a.png

3. Edit the skin template in your favorite image editor, like Photoshop, Gimp, Paint, etc. 
(Some free pixel art editors list: Pixel Art Software List)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/967f69e1ca2c3409d2dea803701eb8f24511b812.png

4. Go back to editor and create a new skins package by clicking on the "Create skins package" button. The skins package is like a folder, which contains all the skins you want to upload. You can create how many skins packages you want.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/cd24f353bf7848e49f39f0d209ecc8637a5fed00.png

5. Create a new skin in the skins package by clicking on the "Add new skin" button and upload the edited skin template. You can create how many skins you want in the skins package.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/4ab99b292c7fbc0561ec6a88b9e53ea1faa1fbca.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/e7ed36f561c4a6f54f9e4c9e1ad24e4d57387f70.png

6. Save everything.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/0bd917a7eb65c62b939969127a97e3ae7f5eb965.png

7. Done! Skins are in the game. They will be visible under "Life" category in the game catalog. You can also upload your skins package to the Steam workshop by clicking on the "Upload to Steam workshop" button.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42528911/58079d4acff1e45bd350c737313a0079944743c6.png

If you find any bugs or have any questions please let me know, thank you. :)
